text:
incident-bot: ALERT: spike in 5xx for inference-gateway-prod (/v1/generate). alert=IGW-5XX-4332 severity=page :rotating_light:
Lina (oncall): I'm on it. starting live debug. :mag:
Lina (oncall): quick look at grafana: error rate jumped to ~15% at ~4332109950, p95 latency up from 120ms -> 850ms.
Mateo (sre): pulling envoy logs from frontend-12: sample lines ->
```
2026-03-15T12:40:20Z "POST /v1/generate" 503 upstream_status=503 upstream_cluster=inference-eu-2
2026-03-15T12:40:21Z "POST /v1/generate" 504 upstream_status=504 upstream_cluster=inference-eu-2
```
Mateo (sre): upstream_cluster inference-eu-2 shows high 5xx.
Priya (infra): checking recent infra changes... found config push commit b7a2f4c at 4332109900 that adjusted route weighting and added route retry_policy {retry_on: 5xx, num_retries: 1}.
Lina (oncall): that timing lines up. retry_on=5xx + uneven weights => potential retry amplification.
Kelly (product): do we have customer reports? CS-ops?
CS-ops: multiple support tickets, two customers with timeouts for live endpoints. flagged as P1 by CS. sending affected client IDs.
Mateo (sre): also seeing envoy circuit_breakers for inference-eu-2 tripped: `cx_overflow` and `rq_pending_overflow` spikes. likely retries pushed already-failing requests back into same pool.
Lina (oncall): mitigation plan: A) temporarily disable route retries for /v1/generate B) rebalance traffic weights back to previous known-good C) scale inference-eu-2 replicas D) raise CB thresholds as a short breathing room. prefer non-invasive first.
Priya (infra): I can toggle route retry via admin API without full rollout. will patch one frontend to verify impact. executing admin PATCH now on frontend-12.
Priya (infra): admin patch applied on frontend-12: removed retry_policy from route /v1/generate.
Lina (oncall): monitoring...
Mateo (sre): on frontend-12 5xx dropped quickly from 18% -> 7% within 30s. good sign.
Kelly (product): hold on customer comms until we see stable trend 5-10m. CS-ops, mark customers as "informed - investigating".
CS-ops: done. initial templated note sent to affected customers.
Priya (infra): performing safe weight rollback next: will roll route weight for eu pools from 60/40 back to 50/50 using a canary step on 10% of frontends.
Mateo (sre): also applying temporary CB bump on inference-eu-2: max_pending_requests +200, max_connections +50. patch id=cb-bump-4332.
deploy-bot: config patch cb-bump-4332 applied by infra at 4332110020.
Lina (oncall): after retry toggle + cb bump + weight canary, cluster-wide 5xx down to 1.5%, p95 back to ~200ms.
Mateo (sre): we should calculate amplification: traffic to eu-2 was 40% originally; with retry_on 5xx and num_retries=1, failing requests likely retried and concentrated back onto eu-2. estimate extra requests to eu-2 = error_rate * retries * traffic_fraction. documenting numbers in ticket.
Priya (infra): saving config dumps and envoy stats: attaching to INC-4332. will collect admin `stats?filter=circuit_breakers` output and `config_dump` for route diffs.
Lina (oncall): next steps: - revert commit b7a2f4c (route retry + weight change) with a safe canary rollout - add pre-deploy check to block route-level retry_on=5xx without perf validation - add automated canary for weight changes (start 5% traffic, ramp) - create an internal playbook entry for retry amplification incidents.
Kelly (product): also request a customer impact summary for legal and SOC. we need list of affected tenants, error counts, and timeline.
CS-ops: aggregated reports: 37 unique customer error reports, 3 escalations. impact window approx 4332109948 - 4332110025 (~77s spike), some residual errors before full mitigation.
Mateo (sre): owning postmortem. will include timeline, config diff (pre/post), amplification calculations, and recommendations: forbid broad "retry_on: 5xx" on gateway routes, prefer client-side idempotency or targeted circuit handling, and require perf canary for weight edits.
Priya (infra): I'll also add a gating check in CI for route changes that modifies `retry_on` or `num_retries` to require a reviewer from SRE.
Lina (oncall): handing off to Mateo for follow-up. I'll monitor for 30m then sign off.
deploy-bot: Revert rollout in progress: revert-commit=b7a2f4c-revert applied at 4332110055 by infra.
Lina (oncall): final live update: system stable; aggregate 5xx ~0.2%. closing paging thread and moving to post-incident channel.
incident-bot: Paging cleared for IGW-5XX-4332 at 4332110076.
